items.title: Veda: The First Agentic Hobby Operating System

Runs Linux in a VM on its own hypervisor to drive GPU/Wi-Fi/USB while Veda drives its own disks
Voice agent uses Deepgram Voice Agent API + OpenAI gpt-4.1-mini, asks confirmation before hard-to-undo actions
62 stars, 6 forks, 208 commits, GPL-3.0; Wi-Fi/audio limited to specific Intel/Realtek chips, English only

Checkpoints updated periodically rather than every step, avoiding per-step state writes

items.reason: artex-ko: a Korean localization fork of a multi-agent LLM pentesting framework (goals/planner/worker agents over a dual knowledge-graph, running real recon/exploit tools behind a MITM proxy). key_facts: Go binary embedding a Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL-backed; AGPL-3.0, fork of Autumn-27/ARTEX
Agent roles: goals (decomposition), planner (intent generation), worker (parallel tool execution), mainagent (human-in-the-loop)
Dual graph model: per-task exploration graph + shared cross-task asset graph linked by anchor tables
Ships defender-facing Sigma/Suricata detection rules, MITRE ATT&CK Navigator layers, and IoC/MISP exports

items.title: mikehasa/golive-skill
items.reason: GoLive: an agent skill + CLI that takes an agent-built app live on the user's own hosting/DNS/payment accounts via a staged detect-plan-approve-apply-verify pipeline with explicit confirm flags for DNS/live/destroy actions. Real running tool (alpha) with live-tested Vercel/Netlify/Supabase/Neon paths, but many features are still mock-covered rather than live-validated.
key_facts: Staged pipeline: detect -> plan -> approve -> apply -> verify, gated by --confirm-dns/--confirm-live/--confirm-destroy flags
Live-tested provider paths: Vercel, Netlify, Supabase, Neon, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Resend, Stripe test mode
Credentials stored locally at ~/.config/golive/credentials, mode 0600, never written to repo/plan/state
Version 0.1.0-alpha.9; rollback limited to Netlify and opt-in
